issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
The sum of the first 100 prime numbers, computed by a short Python script, with a long-running counter job beside it.

1. First start one job on local-compute that counts for two hours, exactly: `ht-resource run local-compute -- python3 -u -c "import time
for i in range(1440): print(i, flush=True); time.sleep(5)"`. Do not wait for it or stop it; it is meant to keep running.
2. Write `code/primes.py`, which prints the sum of the first 100 primes, run it and keep its output in `code/output.txt`.
3. Report: `report/report.md`, two sentences: the sum and how it was computed. No figure, no download.
issue.title: Research objective
